news.headline: NeurAxis Earnings Call Signals High Growth, High Hurdles
news.summary: A post-earnings analysis flagged that NeurAxis's 116% revenue growth is offset by limited payer coverage, operational bottlenecks, and a continuing going-concern warning. Management reiterated it would be "highly disappointed" not to have PENFS covered lives exceed 200 million by 2027.

news.headline: NeurAxis directors and CEO receive equity compensation awards
news.summary: Independent directors Jane Keyser, Bradley Watkins and Kristin Ferge each received stock awards (26,073-31,134 shares at $6.28) as board-service compensation following an independent consultant review, alongside additional RSU grants for CEO Brian Carrico.

news.headline: NeurAxis Reports Record Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results Driven by 116% Year-Over-Year Revenue Growth
news.summary: Q2 2026 revenue rose 116% year-over-year to $1.93M with gross margin near 86%, and the EPS loss of $0.19 beat estimates, but shares still fell about 7% as investors weighed plans for higher spending in the second half of 2026.

news.headline: NeurAxis Expands Payer Coverage with New Policies
news.summary: NeurAxis announced additional medical policy coverage for its PENFS/IB-Stim therapy, adding over 500,000 covered lives and expanding incremental access for beneficiaries in the Mid-Atlantic region.

news.headline: NeurAxis completes shareholder-approved stock option exchange
news.summary: The company's previously approved stock option exchange became effective, cancelling roughly 1.32 million outstanding options and reissuing them 1-for-1 as immediately vesting RSUs, with the largest grants going to CEO Brian Carrico, CMO Adrian Miranda and Chief Regulatory Officer Thomas Carrico.

news.headline: NeurAxis declares Q2 2026 stock dividend on Series B Preferred Stock
news.summary: NeurAxis declared its second-quarter 2026 paid-in-kind dividend to Series B Preferred stockholders, issuing about 80,463 additional common shares at a $2.38 calculation rate, payable July 29, 2026.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings report
catalysts.detail: Based on NeurAxis's recent cadence (Q1 reported May 12, Q2 reported Aug 11, roughly six weeks after quarter-end), Q3 2026 results for the quarter ended September 30 would be expected around mid-November 2026; an official date has not yet been announced.

catalysts.label: Additional national payer coverage decisions
catalysts.detail: Management said it is in active discussions with two large commercial payers and additional distribution channels, and has guided toward PENFS/IB-Stim covered lives exceeding 200 million by 2027.

catalysts.label: Lytham Partners Fall Investor Conference participation
catalysts.detail: NeurAxis has presented at this investor conference in each of the past two years (Sept 30, 2025 and Oct 1, 2024); a 2026 date/participation has not yet been formally announced.

catalysts.label: Pipeline expansion into additional pediatric and adult PENFS indications
catalysts.detail: The company has additional clinical trials of PENFS underway across pediatric and adult GI conditions beyond its current functional abdominal pain/IBS and functional dyspepsia clearances, which could support future FDA submissions and label expansion.

pulse: NeurAxis is scaling IB-Stim (PENFS) commercially on the back of the January 2026 Category I CPT code, with Q2 2026 revenue up 116% YoY to $1.93M and gross margin near 86%, yet shares fell roughly 7% post-earnings as investors weighed rising second-half spending and a continuing going-concern warning. Payer coverage keeps widening (500,000+ more covered lives added in the Mid-Atlantic in early August) and management is guiding toward more than 200 million covered lives by 2027, with two large commercial payers in active discussions. With about $8.3M in cash and roughly $1M in quarterly free cash outflow, dilution risk remains a live overhang alongside the coverage-driven growth story.
